prompts.fx: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production transparent ELEMENTAL IMPACT animation atlas for a polished Vietnamese food-spirit game. Exactly FIVE columns by FIVE rows on a square 1536x1536 transparent canvas, equal square cells, no visible borders, no labels. Each cell contains one single centered isolated circular burst, occupying about 75% of cell, generous transparent gutters, all cells same center. The five columns are successive frames of the same animation: 1 compact bright core, 2 expanding tight ring, 3 rich full bloom, 4 scattered fading ribbons, 5 sparse delicate dissipating fragments. Row 1 ORANGE FIRE: curling flame petals, gold sparks. Row 2 CYAN WATER: spiral water splash with droplets and pearly white arcs. Row 3 EMERALD NATURE: spiraling leaves and green light petals. Row 4 GOLD EARTH: sandstone chips, engraved bronze geometric rings and gold dust. Row 5 PINK SWEET: rosy pearl sparkles, soft flower/star petals. No characters, icons, objects, floor, text, checkerboard or painted background; genuine alpha transparency around every burst and in all cell gaps. Painterly glowing fantasy game VFX, brilliant centers and clean silhouettes, not photographs. Strictly preserve equal 5x5 grid alignment and separate every cell, avoid effects crossing cells. No watermark.
